CustomField.description: When checked, Flows that reference this field do not run for this user. Add NOT({!$User.Bypass_Flows__c}) to a record-triggered Flow's entry conditions, or check it in a Decision at the start of other Flows, to let it be bypassed, for example for an integration or data-migration user. Works alongside the Run Flows switch on the On/Off Switch custom setting.
CustomField.label: Bypass Flows
